help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Find answers to common questions or reach out to us directly.
help.faq0Q: How do I file a complaint?
help.faq0A: Go to 'Submit Complaint' from the dashboard, choose text or voice mode, fill in the incident details, and submit. You'll get a complaint ID to track its status.
help.faq1Q: How long does it take for an FIR to be registered?
help.faq1A: Timelines vary by case, but you can track live status anytime from 'My Complaints' or 'FIR Status'. Each stage — review, draft, verification — is updated in real time.
help.faq2Q: Can I file a complaint in my regional language?
help.faq2A: Yes. NyayaySetu supports Hindi, English, Hinglish, and several regional languages with automatic detection and translation.
help.faq3Q: What if I entered wrong details in my complaint?
help.faq3A: Contact support using the options below, or reach out to the verifying officer once your complaint reaches the 'Officer Verification' stage.
help.faq4Q: Is my personal information kept confidential?
help.faq4A: Yes, your details are only accessible to verified police personnel handling your case.
